item.title: Official Launch of the Buffalo All Access Pilot Project
item.description: The Buffalo Niagara Medical Campus (BNMC) has officially rolled out its new Buffalo All Access app that links the BNMC neighborhood with access to free, automated community shuttles. The Buffalo All Access pilot project – managed by ADASTEC – launched earlier this month, by introducing the first fully automated, on-demand public shuttle at the BNMC. item.description: In response to a comprehensive tourism market study conducted by HVS (a leading hospitality consulting firm), Visit Buffalo is recommending that a new full-service, 400+ room convention center hotel be considered. item.description: On January 15, the Buffalo suffered another big preservation setback due to a four-alarm fire that gutted the former St. Ann’s School on Emslie Street (learn more). item.title: Possible Salvation for At-Risk Kenmore Presbyterian Church Structure?
item.description: There’s good news on the Kenmore Presbyterian Church preservation front.
